title: feat(console): Setup → Integrations → Connector Credentials, and a credential step after a marketplace install
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2zgfxhwFdVq6dfqdLqxCuS)_

Fixes #27238

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@objectstack/service-automation` exports `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_UI_BUNDLE`, `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_COMPONENT_REF` and `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_NAV_CAPABILITY`, and registers a new Setup navigation entry `nav_connector_credentials` resolving component ref `automation:connector-credentials`; no existing key, route or shape changes)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here (`content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`, a Console paragraph pair in the existing "Setting a credential" section rather than a new page, which would have duplicated that section)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：管理员现在可以在 Setup → Integrations → Connector Credentials 页面里查看、设置、替换和清除已安装应用的连接器凭据；从市场安装应用后，安装结果里会直接列出这个应用还缺的凭据，可以当场填，也可以「暂时跳过」，跳过的会给出去设置页的链接。
- 为什么改：按 #27230 裁决 A，托管环境的管理员碰不到服务器环境变量，以前只能调 API 才能填凭据；服务端接口（#27237）已在 main 上，这次补上 Console 这一半。
- 风险与回滚：值永远不回显，输入框始终为空，留空即「不改」，空值不会发出请求；拒绝（多组织隔离形态、无权限、旧服务端没有这些路由）显示为服务器原话的配置说明，不当作红色错误。回滚即 revert 本 PR，服务端行为不变。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/connectorCredentials.ts`（读写规则与安装步骤的过滤），然后是 `ConnectorCredentialsPage.tsx` 和 `console/marketplace/ConnectorCredentialsStep.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/connectorCredentials.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ConnectorCredentialsPage packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/ConnectorCredentialsStep-27238.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.credentialStep-27238.test.tsx`，预期 5 个文件 44 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Setup → Integrations → Connector Credentials** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ConnectorCredentialsPage.tsx`)

- One row per reference from `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs`: the reference, the connectors naming it (with their package), its status badge (`set` / `missing` / `rejected`, with the upstream's reason for `rejected`), its source (`env`, `vault`) and when and by whom it last changed, plus when it was last seen working.
- A masked input (`CredentialValueForm.tsx`, shared with the install step) for each writable, declared reference. It starts empty whatever is stored, Save stays disabled while it is empty, and a save sends exactly `{ value }` with `PUT`. The row then shows the entry the door answered after its reconcile, and the typed value is dropped from state.
- **Clear**, behind a confirmation dialog, for a value stored here (`source: 'object'`). It sends `DELETE` with no body.
- A reference an environment variable supplies is read-only: no input and no Clear, with a sentence saying the variable wins.
- Honesty: `404` / `405` reads "This server does not manage connector credentials"; `403` (missing capability, or the `group` / `isolated` posture), `501` and `503` show the server's own sentence as an informational notice. Only anything else is a red failure, with Try again.

**The entry ships with the door** (triage `6469948452`, cloud ADR-0009 shape)

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credentials-ui.ts` declares `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIALS_UI_BUNDLE`: one `navigationContributions` row into Setup's `group_integrations`, a `component` item `nav_connector_credentials` naming `automation:connector-credentials`, gated on `manage_metadata` (the capability every verb of the door asks).
- `AutomationServicePlugin` registers it through the `manifest` service at `kernel:ready`, after the inert-mode return. A one-shot tool registers nothing, and a kernel with no manifest service boots with no entry.
- App-shell registers the component for that ref in `builtinComponents.tsx`, eagerly like `automation:packaged`. The nav label is translated in the four platform locales, and `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` gains the bundle as a contributor row.

**The credential step after a marketplace install** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ConnectorCredentialsStep.tsx`)

- It reads the same listing, filtered to the package by `connectors[].packageId`, and offers each reference that is not `set`, still declared and writable (so `rejected` is offered and `env` never is). Each has the masked input and **Skip for now**. A value the door answers `set` closes its row; any other answer keeps the row open with its new status. Skipped references stay listed with a link to the Setup page.
- It is mounted in three install results: the package page's install-local banner when the running kernel loaded the package (`hotLoaded: true`), the org-package install on the marketplace page in the same case, and the cloud install dialog / org deploy strip once the app is served in this runtime.
- Where the listing cannot be read (a walled posture), it shows the install answer's `credentialNote` instead.

**Docs and i18n**

- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: what the Console page shows, the read-only env rows, the walled conclusion, and the install step with skip.
- A `connectorCredentials` namespace (43 keys) in all ten Console packs.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts`: `builtInLocales` gets an explicit type. The 43 keys tipped the inferred type of that map past what `tsc` will serialize into the declaration file (`TS7056` on the `@object-ui/i18n` build). Each property is `typeof <pack>`, so the type is unchanged and is emitted as a reference.

## Tests

- `views/setup/connectorCredentials.test.ts` (18): read rules per status, a malformed row dropped, a `200` without `data.credentialRefs` read as a failure and never as an empty list, a network error read as a failure, `PUT` body exactly `{ value }` at the encoded ref, an empty value not sent, `DELETE` with no body, the install-step filter.
- `views/setup/ConnectorCredentialsPage.test.tsx` (13): rows, env read-only, inputs masked and empty, an undeclared stored ref, empty state, Save disabled when empty, save round-trip with the typed value absent from the DOM afterwards, a refusal under the input, clear confirm and cancel, `403` / `404` as notices with no `role="alert"`, `500` with Try again. The posture sentence is transcribed from `connectorCredentialWalledMessage('group')`.
- `views/setup/ConnectorCredentialsPage.navContribution.test.tsx` (3): the production registration, the URL the ref builds, and the page mounting through `ComponentNavView`.
- `console/marketplace/__tests__/ConnectorCredentialsStep-27238.test.tsx` (7) and `MarketplacePackagePage.credentialStep-27238.test.tsx` (3): the package filter, set / rejected / skip, the `credentialNote` fallback, and a real install-local round trip through `marketplaceApi` with `hotLoaded: true`, walled, and `hotLoaded: false` (no step, no listing read).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credentials-ui.test.ts` (5): the bundle parses under `ManifestSchema`; its contribution exactly; a `LiteKernel` boot registers it once at `kernel:ready`; an inert boot and a boot without a manifest service register none.

## Acceptance notes

- **The step is after the install, not before it** (the card says "prompts for the missing refs of the package being installed"). Measured: the door answers `404` for a reference no installed package declares, so a value typed before the install could not be stored. The step opens in the install result, where the package's connectors already exist degraded and materialize as soon as a credential is set, with no restart.
- **Cloud ask `6473504855`: adopted.** The step reads the same `GET …/credential-refs` route the page uses, filtered by package, after any install landing in this runtime: install-local, and a cloud install once its app is served here (the same condition the suggested-bindings panel already uses). It needs no cloud change and no new route. The hosted install path itself stays objectstack-ai/cloud#3352's (triage `6522868103`).
- `Clause-②` measured `yes (widening)` from the diff: three new exports on the published `@objectstack/service-automation` entry and a new Setup nav entry. The seat's claim said `no`.
- Not changed: the dogfood roster `packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` judges object entries only, and this entry is a component, so it needs no row.
- jsdom covers every acceptance bullet above. Only a live stack can show three things: the entry appearing in a real Setup sidebar for an admin and not for a member, a real install-local flipping a degraded connector to ready through the step, and the walled posture's sentence on a `group` deployment. None of the three was run here.

## Verification

Head `e7b058e5`, merged with `origin/main` `139bc181`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 97 derived, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two of them (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`) first exited 3 on missing dists and passed after a full workspace build.
- Builds: `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm turbo run build` for the console closure plus service-automation, platform-objects and cli, then a full workspace build and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`.
